content.text: {"episodes":[{"ep":4,"title":"The Date He Should Not Know","lines":[{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"That photograph proves only one thing. Meera left Dharmapur with me because she wanted to abandon her marriage and her children.","sfx_cue":"committee gavel strike, villagers murmuring"},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Let me ask him one question.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"You will speak when the committee permits it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"This is a police verification, not a punishment meeting. She may question the man in the photograph.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Certainly. A truthful man does not fear questions.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Where was this photograph taken?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Kota bus stand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Which platform?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"There are no platforms at that counter. Only benches.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"So you recognise the place.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"I have worked in transport for twelve years. I recognise hundreds of counters.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Ask why my daughter was standing beside him.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Your daughter? Yesterday, I was a stranger bringing scandal to your courtyard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"He called her an impostor inside the police station.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Now he needs her to be his daughter, because the photograph is public.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"The committee did not summon the street to judge me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"No. The evidence did.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"Raghav, explain the photograph from the beginning.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Meera approached me privately. She said she was unhappy at home. She asked for transport to Kota.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"That is a lie.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"You asked me to speak. Please allow me the courtesy of finishing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Courtesy? You watched while I was taken away.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Meera, taken by whom?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I don't... I did not know his name then. Raghav spoke to him near the tea counter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"She means Shahid. He was arranging labour transport that week.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"You know which man she means without hearing a description.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Because she has made this accusation before. Confused stories travel quickly in a village.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I have not spoken Shahid's name in this village.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Then perhaps your story reached Dharmapur before you did.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"Answer plainly. Did Meera travel with you willingly?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Yes. She sat beside me for three hours. She drank tea. She could have called for help.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You kept my phone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"You said your battery had failed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You removed the battery.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Modern phones do not have removable batteries. Listen to how her memory changes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"It was my old blue phone. The back cover was tied with tape.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"She had a blue phone like that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Many people did.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Hers had white tape across the back. I put it there.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"A daughter repeating a detail does not prove force.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Why would Ma leave without us?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Mohan, don't call her that here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"You cannot stop me thinking it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"Children should be taken inside.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"They are the children Raghav says she abandoned. Their presence is relevant.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"It is also cruel. Tara's school is close to the transport yard, isn't it? Public gossip can be difficult for a girl her age.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Do not bring my daughter's school into your mouth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"I was expressing concern.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Powerful men often call a warning concern. Continue with your account.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Meera wanted work in Kota. She said her family watched every rupee. She said she wanted a life where nobody counted her steps.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I wanted to buy Tara exam guides and Mohan new sandals. That is what I told you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"You told me many things.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Then tell them what happened after the bus stand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"You left with Shahid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You put me in his vehicle.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"I introduced two adults. I did not put anyone anywhere.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Was money discussed?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Transport costs money.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"That was not my question.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"No illegal payment was discussed in my presence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"He counted notes inside the vehicle.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"She was outside the vehicle. Now she was inside. Another change.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I was beside the open door. I saw bundles under the front seat.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Bundles can contain invoices. Transport businesses still use paper.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Meera, if this happened, why did you not return?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Because I was not allowed to return.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"For eighteen months? Not one message? Not one neighbour?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Baba, I tried—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Do not use that word to make an answer disappear.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"She came back. That is an answer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"The boy has more sense than this committee.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"Silence, or I will clear the courtyard.","sfx_cue":"wooden staff striking floor"},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Raghav, did you receive money for arranging Meera's travel?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"A small brokerage fee. Legal and ordinary.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"How much?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Two thousand rupees, perhaps. It was a long time ago.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"That is not the payment he is afraid of.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"There. An accusation without a number, a receipt or a witness.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Did Shahid pay you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Did anyone connected to Shahid transfer money to you, your business or your relatives?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"You may inspect every account for which you have legal authority.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Ask him when it happened.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"When did what happen?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The payment. He knows the date.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"This is becoming theatrical.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"COMMITTEE HEAD","text":"Then end the theatre. Give the committee the date of your two-thousand-rupee brokerage.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"I cannot remember an ordinary fee after eighteen months.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"But you remember how long she sat, where she stood and what she said about her family.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"Because those details became important later.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The larger payment was important immediately.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"RAGHAV","text":"There was no larger payment. The five lakh rupees were not even paid to me. They were paid on the third of May, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Meera has not told police the amount. She only reported that money changed hands.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Yet you have just named the exact five-lakh payment date before Meera told police either the amount or the date.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":5,"title":"The Name in the Ledger","lines":[{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"This door. Break this door, and I will show you where they kept me.","sfx_cue":"metal latch rattling, fists striking wooden door"},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Nobody breaks my property. Show me a warrant or leave my courtyard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Open the room. Refuse again, and I will seal the entire floor until a magistrate decides who enters it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"You police people arrive after eighteen months and speak as though dust committed the crime.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I slept behind that door. I counted the cracks above the window every night.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"I have never rented a room to any Meera.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Then we have travelled to Kota for another false memory.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"She knew the staircase without anyone showing her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"That does not mean she lived here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"There are seventeen steps. The sixth one is broken at the edge. The room has a green wall and no fan regulator.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Every room upstairs has a green wall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"And the broken sixth step?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"People notice stairs while climbing them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"There is a water stain shaped like a hook beside the window.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Enough. The room was rented to another woman.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Sarla.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"That is what Shahid called me in front of strangers.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"I do not know any Shahid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"You answered before I asked whether you knew him.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Because she has repeated the name three times in my courtyard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Madam, open the room. Either her details are correct, or we end this journey here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You are waiting for me to fail.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"I am waiting for evidence that does not change whenever a new person arrives.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"If she is wrong about one stain, will you take her away?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"No. One room does not decide her identity.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Good. Then decide it somewhere else.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Constable, call the local station and request a property seal.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Wait. There is no need to spoil everyone's day over one empty room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"It was not empty when you collected rent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"I collected rent from Sarla's guardian.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Guardian? She was an adult tenant.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"That was the word he used.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Who was he?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"A transport man. I do not remember every customer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You remember enough to change the word landlord into guardian.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"I remember rent paid on time. That is all.","sfx_cue":"keys jangling, padlock opening"},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"The lock opened. Meera stepped inside before anyone invited her.","sfx_cue":"door hinges scraping"},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The cot was against this wall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"It is against the other wall now.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Move it. Please. There should be writing behind the headboard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"There is no writing. I repaint between tenants.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You did not repaint behind the cot.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Constable, move it carefully.","sfx_cue":"wooden cot dragging across cement"},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"There are lines on the wall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Thirty-four vertical marks. Some crossed in groups of seven.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I marked the nights when he took the outside bolt off.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Anyone could make marks.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The last group stops halfway because Shahid came early.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"She is inventing meaning for scratches.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Then tell me why this bedroom door has an outside bolt.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"For luggage security.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM COURTYARD","text":"Luggage does not sleep in the room and cry at night.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Who said that? Come upstairs and give your name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE FROM COURTYARD","text":"We all heard someone. None of us wants our name in your ledger.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"They heard me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"They heard a person. I will take individual statements before deciding more.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Look above the window. The hook-shaped stain.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"It is there.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Stains survive tenants. It could be older than her claim.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Why do you make every correct answer smaller?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Because you are a child, and somebody must protect you from wanting too much.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"I only want Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"You want this woman to be Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"She knows things Ma knew.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Things can be told.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Tara is right to be afraid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Do not tell me what I feel.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Then I won't.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Meera, what else should be in this room? Something removable, not a wall or stain.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"A brass button under the window ledge. I pushed it into a crack.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Now we will search for buttons in an old building?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Yes. Evidence is often smaller than the person hiding it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Why a brass button?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"It came off Mohan's brown sweater. I found it in my blouse pocket after they brought me here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"The sweater with the bear?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"No. The one you hated. Brown wool, wooden train stitched near the collar.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"It scratched my neck.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You cried whenever I pulled it over your ears.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"What did you sing?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Mohan, not here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"What did you sing when I would not put my head through?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Little train, little train, wait beside the door. Mohan has one stubborn head, but Ma has counted four.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"No. You missed the next part.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I don't... I thought you had forgotten it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Sing it properly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"One for anger, one for tears, one that asks for sweets. The fourth comes out when morning starts, and kisses both my cheeks.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Mohan—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"She is my Ma. I am saying it where everybody can hear me. She is my Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE FROM COURTYARD","text":"The boy has recognised his mother.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"A lullaby proves memory, not identity.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Then my memory is better than yours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"I found the crack beneath the ledge.","sfx_cue":"metal scraping against plaster"},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"There is no button. But the plaster has been disturbed recently.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Repairs happen. You cannot arrest a wall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Where is the rental ledger?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"You have seen the room. Leave my records alone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The room was rented under another name. The ledger is now part of the verification.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Old books are downstairs. Some pages may be damaged.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"If one page is missing, the entire ledger goes into evidence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"Downstairs, the landlord opened a steel trunk and lifted out a red cloth book.","sfx_cue":"steel trunk lid opening, paper rustling"},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Here. Sarla. Room twelve. Rent paid in cash.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The tenant column contains a different name, but this signature does not say Sarla.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"That is my name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"No. No, that date cannot be right.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Read it aloud.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"LANDLORD","text":"Twenty-first of June, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"By then, our family believed Meera had already been cremated.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"And beside that date, the rental ledger contains Meera's signature.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":6,"title":"Alive Before the Village","lines":[{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Nobody touches the evidence table. The first person who crosses this rope leaves the verification.","sfx_cue":"crowd pressing against rope, police whistle"},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Then remove Mohan. He is already beside her chair.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"I will sit with my Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"He may sit there. He may not touch the documents.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I want my death certificate placed in front of me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"It is an official record, not an object for public handling.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Place it inside the transparent cover, Babulal.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"If the cover tears, I will record who ordered this.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Record my designation correctly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Yesterday she was locked outside her house. Today her death certificate gets a police chair.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Paper has always received more respect than women here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"This is supposed to be evidence, not entertainment.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Correct. That is why you will not interrupt each item.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"One hour earlier, a sealed fingerprint envelope had fallen through the station slot into an empty records room. Nobody saw it arrive.","sfx_cue":"sealed envelope sliding across floor"},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"Now Kavita placed that envelope beside the certificate recording Meera as dead.","sfx_cue":"paper envelope placed on wooden table"},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The open verification has five parts. Documents. Fingerprints. Family testimony. Physical identifiers. Contradictory records.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"And no final declaration until every objection is entered.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Agreed. Read the first document.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"School admission register. Student name, Meera. Father's name, Devraj. Original left-thumb impression attached.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"That register is old. Ink spreads.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Your objection is noted before the result has even been opened.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"He is frightened.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"I am frightened of another mistake being made in public.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The first mistake was made in public too. You called a burned body your daughter, then called your living daughter a stranger.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"She has spoken the truth plainly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"You saw no face in that hospital either.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"I was not asked to identify the body.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Enough. Babulal, the second document.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"Ration-card amendment form. Signed by Meera. Right-thumb impression taken two years before her disappearance.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The forensic unit compared both archived impressions with the fresh prints taken at the station.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Was the unit told what result the police expected?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The samples were coded. The examiner received no names.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"What does the envelope say?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"You may come closer, Tara. Do not cross the rope.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"I can hear from here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The fresh left-thumb impression matches the school register impression at fourteen corresponding ridge characteristics.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Fourteen points. Say what that means.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"It means the old and new left-thumb impressions were made by the same person.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"Ma's thumb remembers her, even if Nana does not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"A child should not humiliate his grandfather before a crowd.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"You humiliated Ma before a bigger crowd.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Mohan, sit down.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"I am sitting.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"Then sit quietly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MOHAN","text":"All right, Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The right-thumb impression also matches the ration-card form.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"Both archived documents existed before the disappearance. Their dates and storage entries are verified.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"What about the Kota ledger? It carries her signature after the cremation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"That is the contradictory-record section. We will reach it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Conveniently last.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Conveniently in the order I announced before you objected.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Physical identifiers. Meera, show both hands.","sfx_cue":"camera shutter clicks"},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"The tattoo is on my left hand. It has always been on my left hand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"BABULAL","text":"The hospital photograph shows the burned body's tattoo beside the right wrist.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"The photograph number and hospital intake number are legible. There is no reversal in the image.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"The black thread looked identical.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"A black wrist thread is not unique. A tattoo on the opposite hand is a material discrepancy.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"You did not touch the body, Baba. You would not even touch my hand at the station.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"The body was burned. I was told not to disturb it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Who told you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"A hospital worker. I don't... there were several people speaking at once.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Name or description?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Then your statement remains that an unidentified worker discouraged a physical check.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"I was grieving.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"MEERA","text":"And I was alive.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Family testimony. Tara, what did Meera know inside the house?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"She knew where my first school ribbon was hidden.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"DEVRAJ","text":"Someone could have told her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"I did not tell anyone the tin was behind the loose brick.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Did she find it without directions?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"Yes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"KAVITA","text":"Do you recognise her as your mother?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"TARA","text":"I recognise things she knows.
